EXPERTISE & SERVICES

The areas I work in, explained in detail.

A closer look at my experience in itinerary planning, visa documentation support, airline ticketing, accommodation, safaris, travel insurance guidance, customer care and supplier coordination.

Nairobi, Kenya · Travel consulting · Tours and reservations · Client support

Travel planning and itinerary development

Turning a traveller’s goals into a practical, organized travel plan.

I prepare and coordinate travel itineraries for leisure, safari, group, corporate and multi-destination trips. This work involves understanding the client’s travel purpose, preferred dates, destination interests, available budget and practical requirements, then organizing the journey into a clear sequence of arrangements. For international travel, this can include reviewing routing options, connection points, time between services, destination logistics and the relationship between flights, accommodation and planned activities.

When preparing an itinerary, I aim to present information in a way that is easy to follow and useful during planning. I coordinate the travel components that fit the request, such as flights, hotel stays, transfers, excursions and ground transportation. I also help clients understand which items are included in a quotation and which may require separate arrangements or confirmation.

Visa application and travel documentation support

Visa and travel documentation support is another important area of my experience. I have supported more than 300 visa applications by helping clients understand document checklists, organize supporting records and prepare their application materials for review. My experience includes working with documentation requirements for different destinations and helping travellers understand the steps and information that may be required before submission.

This work calls for care, organization and clear communication. I help clients identify missing or inconsistent information, understand the purpose of supporting documents and keep their paperwork organized. I also provide general guidance on destination entry requirements and travel formalities based on the information available for the case. Visa decisions remain entirely with the relevant embassy, consulate or immigration authority, so I do not promise approvals or present documentation support as a guarantee of an outcome.

Because requirements can change and individual circumstances differ, I treat each application according to the client’s destination and situation. I encourage clients to confirm current official instructions before submission and to provide complete, accurate information in their applications.

Airline reservations and ticketing

My airline work includes using Amadeus GDS to search and create reservations, review flight options, calculate fares, issue tickets and assist with reissues, refunds and itinerary changes. I understand the importance of checking passenger details, travel dates, routing, fare conditions and ticketing requirements carefully before a booking is finalized. Small errors can have a significant impact on a traveller’s plans, so accuracy and careful verification are central to this work.

I help clients compare available flight options in relation to their route, schedule and budget, and explain relevant booking details so they can make informed choices. Where travel plans change, I assist with checking the applicable conditions and available alternatives. My CV also records basic familiarity with Sabre, alongside experience using travel booking and supplier platforms.

Hotel reservations and accommodation planning

I support hotel research, quotations, reservations and accommodation coordination for individuals, families, groups and wider travel itineraries. Accommodation planning requires more than identifying a property; it means checking whether the location, room arrangement, meal plan, dates, availability and price suit the client’s needs. I work to present suitable options and coordinate the booking details with the broader itinerary.

My experience includes working with accommodation and distribution platforms such as RateHawk, TBO, Hotelbeds, WebBeds and online travel resources. I have also worked with hotel and supplier partners to seek appropriate rates and value for clients. My CV notes that supplier-rate negotiation contributed to approximately 20% in client cost savings in my previous work.

Safari planning, tours and ground arrangements

My tours and safari experience includes helping develop travel plans that bring together accommodation, transfers, excursions, guides and local ground services. For safari travel, the details must work together: the route, lodge or camp arrangements, transport, planned activities, group requirements and overall duration all affect the experience. I coordinate these components according to the trip brief and help ensure the client has a clear understanding of the proposed arrangements.

I also support holiday packages and group travel, including the coordination of services supplied by different partners. This requires follow-up with suppliers, attention to booking conditions and the ability to respond when availability or client preferences change. My aim is to create an itinerary that is coherent and realistic rather than simply a list of disconnected reservations.

Travel insurance and destination requirements

I provide travel insurance guidance as part of the wider travel-planning process, helping clients understand that insurance options and coverage should be considered alongside their destination, trip length and activities. I also help clients identify destination information and travel formalities that may affect their preparation. Specific policy coverage, eligibility and entry rules need to be confirmed with the relevant insurer or official authority.

Customer service, B2B support and supplier relationships

Across my roles, I have supported direct customers and business-to-business travel requirements. I communicate with clients to understand their needs, explain options, respond to questions, follow up on bookings and assist with resolving service issues. I know that travel arrangements can change quickly, so I place importance on keeping people informed and approaching problems calmly and practically.

Supplier liaison is part of delivering reliable service. I coordinate with hotels, travel partners and ground-service providers to request availability, clarify arrangements and address booking issues. I also understand the importance of maintaining professional relationships and organized records, because these support continuity of service and can contribute to repeat business and referrals.

Systems and digital tools

My travel technology experience includes Amadeus GDS, basic Sabre, TBO, RateHawk, Hotelbeds, WebBeds, Booking.com, Expedia, Viator and TripAdvisor. For customer relationships, support and day-to-day coordination, my CV also lists HubSpot CRM, Zoho CRM, Zendesk, Microsoft Office, Google Workspace, Microsoft Teams, Zoom and Slack. I use these systems according to the task, whether that involves checking travel options, coordinating reservations, organizing client information or communicating with colleagues and partners.
